goal: Customers can pay for an order and recover from payment failures.
scope: Order payment; refunds are outside this story.

blocks.outcome: An order receives a payment session.
acceptance: An unpaid order receives exactly one active payment session.

blocks.outcome: Confirmed payments update the order exactly once.
acceptance: Repeated payment notifications do not duplicate order fulfillment.

integration: A customer completes payment and the order reaches paid status.
A failed payment can be retried without duplicate fulfillment.
